enabled.description: Whether the borgbackup2 service is enabled.

description.description: Optional description for the unit file comment.

repository_url.description: Repository URL (local path, ssh://, sftp://, rclone:, or (s3|b2): scheme).

repository_encryption.description: If true, use BORG_PASSPHRASE to supply the passphrase (insecure for automation; prefer BORG_PASSCOMMAND).

repository_passphrase.description: Passphrase for encrypted repositories. Only used if repository_encryption is true. WARNING: plaintext in config.

archive_name.description: Name pattern for the archive. May include strftime directives.

backup_sources.description: List of source paths/directories to back up.

extra_args.description: Additional arguments passed to `borg create`. Example: ['--exclude-caches', '--one-file-system'].

prune_schedule.description: Systemd timer calendar expression (e.g., daily, weekly) for pruning. If empty, no pruning timer is created.
